_source: README Expected outcomes — E2E-01 mergewatch.ai#626: the clean-verdict wording changed from "All clear! No issues found — this PR looks good to go" to "Looks good to me! I didn't find anything worth raising in this diff". The old text asserted ABSENCE the review never verified (nothing checks that silence was right) and appended a merge recommendation covering tests and CI that MergeWatch never reads. The new phrasing is a first-person judgement, which is what the product is actually entitled to say — it already submits a formal APPROVE at 4-5.
